modules.complete_printed_types:
@CurrentMain.LocatedCompactEntry.recoverAt_sound : ∀ {n : ℕ} (artifact fragment : ByteArray) (start : ℕ) (key : String)
  (update coefficients : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n)
  (r : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.CheckedEntry n),
  CurrentMain.LocatedCompactEntry.recoverAt n artifact fragment start key update coefficients = some r →
    start + fragment.size ≤ artifact.size ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin fragment.size), ∃ (hi : start + ↑i < artifact.size), artifact.data[start + ↑i] = fragment.data[↑i]) ∧
        artifact.data.extract 0 start ++ fragment.data ++ artifact.data.extract (start + fragment.size) artifact.size =
            artifact.data ∧
          (∃ wholeText dictionary text raw,
              String.fromUTF8? artifact = some wholeText ∧
                Lean.Json.parse wholeText = Except.ok dictionary ∧
                  String.fromUTF8? fragment = some text ∧
                    Lean.Json.parse text = Except.ok raw ∧
                      dictionary.getObjVal? key = Except.ok raw ∧
                        CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.decodeColumns n raw = some r.columns ∧
                          CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2
                              (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue r.columns) =
                            raw) ∧
            fragment = CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload r.columns ∧
              (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.natValues r.columns).length = n ∧
                (∀ (j : Fin n), CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.columnFunction r.columns j < 2 ^ n) ∧
                  CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns =
                      ↑(CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.checkedEquiv ↑r.certificate ⋯) ∧
                    (∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
                        CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate)
                            ((CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns) x) =
                          x) ∧
                      ∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
                        (CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns)
                            (CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate) x) =
                          x
@CurrentMain.LocatedCompactEntry.recoverAt_complete : ∀ {n : ℕ} (artifact : ByteArray) (start : ℕ)
  (dictionary : Lean.Json) (key : String) (cols : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.Columns n)
  (c : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Candidate n) (h : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.check c = true)
  (hc : c.columns = CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.columnFunction cols),
  CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.dictionaryColumns n dictionary key = some cols →
    CurrentMain.CheckedArraySlice.checkBytes artifact (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload cols) start = true →
      CurrentMain.ByteJsonGlobalCall.parseBytes artifact = Except.ok dictionary →
        CurrentMain.ByteJsonGlobalCall.parseBytes (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload cols) =
            Except.ok
              (CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2
                (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue cols)) →
          CurrentMain.LocatedCompactEntry.recoverAt n artifact (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload cols) start
              key c.updateVector c.coefficients =
            some { columns := cols, certificate := ⟨c, h⟩, column_match := ⋯ }

scope.generic_coverage: All arrays with decidable equality, and all byte artifacts/fragments/dimensions/keys in the stated theorem domains.
scope.finite_coverage: No new closed finite decisions, selected table census or concrete artifact witness is included.
scope.conditional_coverage: Successful executed checks imply exact containment, parser/named-column facts and recovered operator/inverses. Restricted completeness retains slice, actual parser and checked-Candidate premises.
scope.full_multiplication_coverage: Not established. No endpoint multiplication, physical realization or total cost theorem is added.
open_boundaries: Literal offset containment does not establish the parser structural field span.
Whole artifact file/source identity and cryptographic digest authentication.
Installed parser specification/duplicate-key policy and general parser roundtrip.
Python serializer/runtime extern refinement, complex phases, physical execution and time/space costs.

acceptance_limits: Source-bound prior kernel acceptance and independent review; this publication preparation did not rerun compilers or assert external CI success.
